TASK
 A porridge vendor who sells porridge on a construction site wants to make a sieve so that her
porridge is made of well sieved flour.
1. Make a freehand pictorial sketch to show how the sieve will look like and indicate the
 measurements. (6 marks)
2. Choose locally available materials such as wood, metal, plastic etc for making the sieve. (3 marks)
3. Select appropriate tools from the following.
 - Tape measure
 - Try square
 - Hacksaw
 - Tenon saw
 - Panga
 - Steel rule
 - Hammer
 - Chisel
 - Knife
a) List the tools selected. (3 mark)
b) Use the selected tools for marking out and cutting the parts. (10 marks)
4. Assemble the parts to make the sieve. (6 marks)
5. Take videos/photos as you carry out each of the project tasks. (2 marks)
6. Create an electronic portfolio containing the videos/photos taken in 6(a). (2 marks)
7. Name the electronic portfolio your ‘Group name’. (2 marks)
8. State three qualities that describe the porridge vendor as an entrepreneur. (3 marks)
9. Outline three benefits of making the sieve instead of buying. (3 marks)
